metadata.description: The CloudGrid plugin for Claude Code: skills for planning, building, and plugging apps and pages into CloudGrid, plus the CloudGrid connector.

plugins.name: cloudgrid
plugins.description: Plug apps and pages into CloudGrid: a project folder goes live through the grid CLI, content from the conversation goes live through the CloudGrid connector. Apps get managed MongoDB, Redis, pgvector, persistent disk, and an AI gateway that needs no API key.
